summary: Task 8 frontend settings page reviewed against the six focus areas (XSS, authz reliance, sensitive data, CSRF, open redirect, type-to-confirm bypass). No vulnerabilities found. Mutations (PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id}, DELETE /api/v1/projects/{id}) route through useApi(), which injects X-XSRF-TOKEN from the XSRF-TOKEN cookie on non-safe methods. All template interpolations use Vue's escaped {{ }} or vue-i18n's safe placeholder interpolation (no v-html, no innerHTML, no dangerous DOM APIs). The project.name pass-through in the modal label uses {name} positional interpolation, which vue-i18n escapes by default. navigateTo only sees hardcoded path literals ('/dashboard' or '/projects'); no user input ever reaches the redirect. The delete confirmation gate (isDeleteEnabled + isDeleting + isDeleteModalOpen) blocks accidental client-side activation, while backend remains the authoritative authz boundary — the page does not pretend to enforce ownership client-side. The single console.warn for an absent Intl.supportedValuesOf logs only the resolved timezone string (no PII, IDs, or secrets). Verdict: approve.
